newsitem.title: USA: US Treasury 10-year notes seen yielding 3.6075 pct.
newsitem.headline: US Treasury 10-year notes seen yielding 3.6075 pct.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury's auction of $8.0 billion in 10-year Treasury Index Protected securities (TIPS) on Tuesday is expected to produce a yield near 3.6075 pct, dealers said.
Shortly before the bidding deadline of 1300 EDT/1700 GMT, the 10-year notes were trading with a when-issued yield of 3.6125 percent.
Results for the auction are expected around 1345 EDT/1745 GMT. (( -- North American Treasury Desk, 212-859-1679 ))
